DP-GES was proposed by Keyang Ye, Hongzhi Wu, and Kun Zhou from Zhejiang University and Hangzhou Research Institute of Holographic and AI Technology.

It is an improved variant of Gaussian-Enhanced Surfels (GES) [42], addressing GES's limitations of aliasing artifacts and suboptimal reconstruction by introducing semi-transparent surfel boundaries and depth peeling.
